rows.title: MOVIE REVIEW : 'CLOUDS'--A MASTERPIECE REVISITED
rows.comment: Much of the powerful effect of “Floating Clouds” comes from a paradox.
rows.verdict_le10: Much of the powerful effect of “Floating Clouds” comes from a paradox.
rows.dek_lead: Outside, the streets have a a melancholy vitality (Naruse’s evocation of the postwar mood is superb, created by discreet glimpses around the edges). Life has little hope to offer, but one Yukiko seizes is that Tomioka’s love can be regained
